''For a summary of all translated versions of The Wheel of Time see [[The Wheel of Time translations]].''

In French, the Wheel of Time translates as ''La Roue du Temps''.

The original translations and printings of the series in French was split into two volumes for each of one in English, often with unique names not corresponding to direct translations of the English titles or chapters.

Only those books written by Robert Jordan had translations until 2010. After his death, his wife and editor, Harriet McDougal, commissioned an audit of the French translation to understand why his work had not achieved the same success in France as it had elsewhere. The review revealed a chaotic editorial history, which accounted for the series' mixed reception. This prompted a change in publishers and single-volume new editions of the books to be released from 2010. The final three books were finally translated and published in this format in 2021 and 2022.<ref>[https://fr.wikipedia.org/wiki/La_Roue_du_temps The Wheel of Time, Wikipedia article in French]</ref>

The same publisher also began to release smaller paperbacks, again in two parts, from 2019 onwards, with the second part of [[A Memory of Light]] being published in Dec 2024. These parts were renamed "Part One" and "Part Two" of translations of the English titles.

Audiobooks for the books written by Robert Jordan up to [[Crossroads of Twilight]], with the addition of [[New Spring]], were released between May 2019 and Oct 2020. [[Knife of Dreams]] and the books co-written by Brandon Sanderson were released later, between Jan 2022 and Jan 2023. The narrator for all audiobooks is Arnauld Le Ridant.

Uniquely, the Wheel of Time in French has a companion volume that is made up of maps from the books.

==Book titles==
The books of the series, along with rough translations of the titles of each book are given below.

*''Nouveau Printemps, 2012'' - ''New Spring''

#''L'Invasion des Ténèbres'', 1990 - The Invasion of Darkness
##''L'Invasion des Ténèbres | La Roue du Temps'' (1995) - The Invasion of Darkness | The Wheel of Time
##''L'Œil du Monde'' (1995) - The Eye of the World
#''La Grande Chasse,'' 1990 - The Great Hunt
##''Le Cor de Valère'' (1996) - The Horn of Valere
##''La Bannière du Dragon'' (1997) - The Banner of the Dragon
#''Le Maître du Mal'', 1991 - The Master of Evil
##''Le Dragon Réincarné'' (1998) - The Dragon Reborn
##''Le Jeu des Ténèbres'' (1999) - The Game of Shadows
#''Le Crépuscule du Monde'', 1992 - The Twilight of the World
##''La Montée des Orages'' (2000) - The Rise of Storms
##''Tourmentes'' (2000) - Turmoil
#''Les Feux du Ciel'' , 1993 - The Fires of Heaven
##''Étincelles'' (2001) - Sparks
##''Les Feux du Ciel'' (2001) - The Fires of Heaven
#''Le Seigneur du Chaos'' (''Lord of Chaos''), 1994 - The Lord of Chaos
##''Le Seigneur du Chaos'' (2003) - The Lord of Chaos
##''L'Illusion Fatale'' (2004) - The Terrible Illusion
#''Une Couronne d'épées'' (''A Crown of Swords''), 1996 - A Crown of Swords
##''Une Couronne d'épées'' (2007) - A Crown of Swords
##''Les Lances de Feu'' (2007) - The Lances of Fire
#''Le Sentier des Dagues'', 1998 - The Path of Daggers
##''Le Sentier des Dagues'' (2008) - The Path of Daggers
##''Alliances'' (2008) - Alliances
#''Le Coeur de l'Hiver'', 2000 - Winter's Heart
##''Le Coeur de l'Hiver'' (2009) - Winter's Heart
##''Perfidie'' (2009) - Treachery
#''Le Carrefour des ombres'', 2003 - The Crossroad of Shadows
##''Le Carrefour des ombres'' (2010) - The Crossroads of Shadows
##''Secrets'' (2010) - Secrets
#''Le Poignard des rêves'', 2005 - Knife of dreams 
##''Le Poignard des rêves'' (2010) - Knife of Dreams
##''Le Prince des corbeaux'' (2010) - Prince of Ravens
#''La Tempête imminente, 2021'' 
##''La Tempête imminente: première partie'' - The Coming Storm: Part One (2023)
##''La Tempête imminente: deuxième partie'' - The Coming Storm: Part Two (2023)
#''Les Tours de Minuit, 2022'' 
##''Les Tours de Minuit: première partie'' - The Towers of Midnight: Part One (2024)
##''Les Tours de Minuit: deuxième partie'' - The Towers of Midnight: Part Two (2024)
#''Un souvenir de Lumière, 2022'' 
##''Un souvenir de Lumière: première partie'' - A Memory of Light: Part One (2024)
##''Un souvenir de Lumière: deuxième partie'' - A Memory of Light: Part Two (2024)
